narrative.northStar: The heating system as a railway line
narrative.overview: Devices are stations, connections are track, and a fault is a closed section drawn hollow. A ruled status board above the map answers the household's question in three plain rows.
keyCharacteristics: Hollow track for a closed section
Status board with plain state phrases
Warm map paper by day, deep blue-black by night

rules.name: The Line Rule
rules.body: Green is the line. It never appears as decoration or as a button.

rules.name: The Not-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state is carried in line form and in words as well as colour.

dos: Put the household answer in the board, in plain words, first.
Draw every state in line form as well as colour.
Point at the first broken link only.
donts: Don't use line green for anything but working track.
Don't put coloured stripes on rows or panels.
Don't reword the Try this lines without asking the household.
